description: This file defines the TaskQueue class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, implementing a FIFO task queue to execute asynchronous tasks and manage promise settlement downstream, with optional shutdown handling.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A FIFO task queue for executing asynchronous promise-related tasks with optional shutdown handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the task queue, optionally registering a shutdown function to run remaining tasks.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task (callable) to the queue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all tasks in the queue in FIFO order.

methods.name: disableShutdown
methods.description: Disables automatic task queue execution upon script shutdown.
